zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Riverdale Borough Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.64%, with an equalization ratio of 82.5%.

Average residential assessment is $379,500, producing an average annual tax bill of $10,018.8.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Riverdale Borough, homeowners pay an average of $10,018.8 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.07% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 82.5%, assessed values average ~82.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 61.5% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 28.5%, and Morris County claims 10.0%.
